title: Persist validation evidence manifests for finalized tasks
description: Record validation commands, pass/fail evidence, quality gates, and skipped-gate reasons as structured task delivery metadata. Operators should be able to inspect what proved a task safe before integration.

userStories.title: Capture structured validation evidence
userStories.description: Persist command, cwd, duration, exit code, stdout/stderr summary, and quality gate classification for each validation run used by finalization.
acceptanceCriteria: Completed tasks include a validation evidence manifest in task state or a linked artifact.
Failed gates record enough diagnostic data for repair without storing excessive logs inline.
Skipped gates require explicit reason metadata.

userStories.title: Expose evidence in status and queue views
userStories.description: Operators can see which gates passed, failed, or were skipped without opening raw logs.
acceptanceCriteria: status JSON includes validation evidence summary.
queue compact output includes whether terminal tasks have validation evidence.

userStories.title: Use evidence for future repair and audits
userStories.description: Make evidence available to retry, repair prompts, and Oracle packets without recomputing stale diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Retry/finalize repair can include the latest validation evidence summary.
Tests cover passed, failed, timed-out, and skipped validation evidence.
